# Module `lune_ui_core::image`

[API reference](../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_core`](index.md)

Images: the plain data an app registers once under an [`ImageId`](image.md#struct.ImageId), the [`ImageStore`](image.md#trait.ImageStore) seam a
renderer implements to hold the pixels, and the pure fit geometry both sides share. The
toolkit decodes no file format and fetches nothing: the app hands over RGBA.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/image.rs:1`

<a id="struct.ImageData"></a>
### Struct `ImageData`

```rust
pub struct ImageData {
    pub width: u32,
    pub height: u32,
    pub rgba: Vec<u8>,
}
```

A decoded picture: `rgba` is `width * height` pixels of 8-bit red, green, blue, alpha, row by
row from the top left, with straight (not premultiplied) alpha.

### Enum `ImageError`

```rust
pub enum ImageError {
    BadLength,
```

Why a store refused a picture. A refusal changes nothing: a replaced id keeps its old picture.

## Traits

<a id="trait.ImageStore"></a>
### Trait `ImageStore`

```rust
pub trait ImageStore { .. }
```

Where registered pictures live. The renderer implements it; the painter only names ids, so an
id that is unknown or released draws nothing.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/image.rs:49`

**Required items**

- <a id="tymethod.ImageStore.register"></a>`fn register(&mut self, id: ImageId, data: ImageData) -> Result<(), ImageError>`

  Stores `data` under `id`, replacing and freeing what the id held. A refusal leaves the
  store as it was.

  ###### Errors
  [`ImageError::BadLength`](image.md#variant.ImageError.BadLength) when `data.rgba` is not `4 * width * height` bytes;
  [`ImageError::TooLarge`](image.md#variant.ImageError.TooLarge) when a side is above the store's limit.

- <a id="tymethod.ImageStore.release"></a>`fn release(&mut self, id: ImageId)`

  Frees `id`; does nothing for an id that is not registered. The id may be registered again.
